title: Ptolemy Converse: Equality Characterizes Cyclic Quadrilaterals

problemStatement.formal: theorem ptolemy_converse (A B C D : Circle.unitCircle ℂ) (hne : A ≠ B ∧ B ≠ C ∧ C ≠ D ∧ D ≠ A) : dist A C * dist B D = dist A B * dist C D + dist A D * dist B C → IsCyclicOrder A B C D
problemStatement.plain: If four distinct unit-circle points satisfy Ptolemy equality AC·BD = AB·CD + AD·BC, then they appear in cyclic (CCW or CW) order — completing the bidirectional characterization of cyclic quadrilaterals.
whyMatters: Completes the converse of Ptolemy's theorem for unit-circle points
Provides a metric characterization of cyclic order without angular arguments
Parent proof established the forward direction; this is the natural completion
